title: Citation appendix paragraph consolidation profile

change.description: Citation titles and metadata share a paragraph with visible line breaks. A single call reference shares that paragraph when no rendered citation media separates it; media and multiple-call lists retain their existing order and structure.

method.timer: Python time.perf_counter() around write_latex_pdf after fixture and media preparation

interpretation.wall_comparison_note: One run per variant; the reference was measured with CPython 3.14.0 and the candidate with CPython 3.12.14. This does not establish a compile-time regression or improvement.

method.wall_clock_timer: Python time.perf_counter() around direct subprocess.run of one LuaLaTeX pass.
method.instrumentation: Two Lua os.clock() markers were inserted before the Documentary appendix and Person index section headings in a temporary source copy.

interpretation.comparison_scope: One pass per variant on the same macOS and LuaHBTeX version with the same synthetic fixture. The prior profile used CPython 3.14.0 while this run used CPython 3.12.14; CPU checkpoints come from Lua os.clock(). These measurements are indicative, not a multi-run qualification.

limits: The N=1000 result is one diagnostic pass; references are not converged, so its PDF is not a final preview.
The N=1000 candidate wall time still exceeds both production time limits.
One run per variant does not establish a stable performance percentage.
The candidate PDF was visually inspected on the appendix start, continuation, final appendix, index start, and final page; this does not constitute a full-page review.
Synthetic records and portraits only; no PDF/UA conformance claim is made.
